newsitem.title: USA: Access Beyond Q3 April 30 net loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Access Beyond Q3 April 30 net loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1997 Q3 included a loss of $300,000, or $0.03/shr, from the disposal of discontinued operations. 1997 Q3 also included income from discontinued operations of $23,000.
1997 nine mos included merger related expenses of $4,076,000, income from a lawsuit settlement of $3,547,000 and a loss of $593,000 for disposal of discontinued operations.
1996 nine months included income from discontinued operations of $156,000, or $0.01 per share.

Access Beyond Inc was spun-off from Penril DataComm Networks Inc PNRL.O in November 1996 in a tax free distribution to Penril shareholders. After the spin-off, Bay Networks Inc acquired the remaining business of Penril by merger. Access Beyond, Penril's successor company, has reported its ongoing business operations combined with and in comparison to the previous resuts of Penril.
